Health.Overview:
Health governs how much passive Flinch Resistance you have while aiming down sights (ADS) and how much health collecting Orbs of Power restores.

When enhanced, it reduces your Shields' Recharge Delay and increases their Recharge Rate in all activities, as well as increasing their total HP in PvE activities.
Health.BaseStatTooltip:
Grants you {{FlinchResistance}}{{Percent}} Flinch Resistance while ADS and makes Orbs of Power restore {{OrbOfPowerHealthRestore}}{{HP}} on pickup.

Your Health has {{PVEDamageResistance}}{{Percent}} Damage Resistance against combatants in PvE. (Health is the left side portion of your HP bar)

Your Health starts regenerating {{HealthRegenDelay}}{{Time}} after taking damage, at a rate of {{HealthRegenSpeed}}{{PercentPerSecond}}. Your Health has {{PVPHealthHP}}{{HP}} in most PvP activities and {{PVEHealthHP}}{{HP}} in PvE activities.

Your Shields start recharging {{BaseShieldRechargeDelay}}{{Time}} after taking damage, at a rate of {{BaseShieldRechargeSpeed}}{{PercentPerSecond}}. Your Shields have {{BaseShieldHP}}{{HP}}.
Health.EnhancedStatTooltip:
Grants you {{FlinchResistance}}{{Percent}} Flinch Resistance while ADS and makes Orbs of Power restore {{OrbOfPowerHealthRestore}}{{HP}} on pickup.

Your Health has {{PVEDamageResistance}}{{Percent}} Damage Resistance against combatants in PvE.

Your Health starts regenerating {{HealthRegenDelay}}{{Time}} after taking damage, at a rate of {{HealthRegenSpeed}}{{PercentPerSecond}}. Your Health has {{PVPHealthHP}}{{HP}} in most PvP activities and {{PVEHealthHP}}{{HP}} in PvE activities.

{{Enhancement}} Your Shields start recharging {{ShieldRechargeDelay}}{{Time}} after taking damage, at a rate of {{ShieldRechargeSpeed}}{{PercentPerSecond}}. Your Shields have {{BaseShieldHP}}{{HP}}, plus {{PVEBonusShieldHP}}{{HP}} in PvE activities.

Melee.Overview:
Melee governs your Melee Ability's passive cooldown and how much Melee Energy you gain from external sources.

Increases Melee Damage when enhanced.
Melee.BaseStatTooltip: Your Melee Ability has a {{Cooldown}}{{Time}} passive cooldown and external sources of Melee Energy function at {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness.
Melee.EnhancedStatTooltip:
Your Melee Ability has a {{Cooldown}}{{Time}} passive cooldown and external sources of Melee Energy function at {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness.

{{Enhancement}} Your Melee Ability deals {{PVEMeleeDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage in PvE and {{PVPMeleeDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage in PvP.

Grenade.Overview:
Grenade governs your Grenade Ability's passive cooldown and how much Grenade Energy you gain from external sources.

Increases Grenade Damage when enhanced.

Warlock grenades inherently recharge 10% faster and deal 5%|2.5% more damage in PvE|PvP.
Grenade.BaseStatTooltip: Your Grenade Ability has a {{Cooldown}}{{Time}} passive cooldown, and external sources of Grenade Energy function at {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness.
Grenade.EnhancedStatTooltip:
Your Grenade Ability has a {{Cooldown}}{{Time}} passive cooldown, and external sources of Grenade Energy function at {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness.

{{Enhancement}} Your Grenade Ability deals {{PVEGrenadeDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage in PvE and {{PVPGrenadeDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage in PvP.

Super.Overview:
Super governs how much Super energy you gain from Orbs of Power, Perks, or other sources.

Enhanced Super stat increases Super damage in PvE and PvP. Well of Radiance and Ward of Dawn have an enhanced duration benefit; whether that replaces or adds to any Super damage change is unconfirmed.
Super.BaseStatTooltip: Your Super Ability's passive cooldown does not depend on the Super stat. External sources of Super Energy (Orbs of Power, exchanging damage, perks, etc.) function at {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness in PvE and {{PVPEnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness in PvP.
Super.EnhancedStatTooltip:
Your Super Ability's passive cooldown does not depend on the Super stat. External sources of Super Energy (Orbs of Power, exchanging damage, perks, etc.) function at {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness in PvE and {{PVPEnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness in PvP.

{{Enhancement}} Your Super Ability deals {{SuperDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage in PvE and {{PVPSuperDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage in PvP. For Well of Radiance and Ward of Dawn, the enhanced benefit is increased duration (shown in their ability details); whether this replaces or adds to the Super damage increase is unconfirmed.

2274196887.EnhancedDurationTooltip: Enhanced Super stat increases {{AbilityName}}'s duration by {{SuperDurationIncrease}}{{Percent}}, from {{BaseDuration}}{{Time}} to {{SuperDuration}}{{Time}}. Whether this duration benefit replaces or adds to the Super Damage increase is unconfirmed.

4260353953.EnhancedDurationTooltip: Enhanced Super stat increases {{AbilityName}}'s duration by {{SuperDurationIncrease}}{{Percent}}, from {{BaseDuration}}{{Time}} to {{SuperDuration}}{{Time}}. Whether this duration benefit replaces or adds to the Super Damage increase is unconfirmed.

Class.Overview:
Class governs your Class Ability's passive cooldown and how much Class Ability Energy you gain from external sources.

When enhanced, casting your Class Ability grants you an Overshield and damaging Class Abilities deal increased damage.
Class.BaseStatTooltip: Your Class Ability has a {{Cooldown}}{{Time}} passive cooldown and external sources of Class Ability Energy function at {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness.
Class.EnhancedStatTooltip:
Your Class Ability has a {{Cooldown}}{{Time}} passive cooldown and external sources of Class Ability Energy function at {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness.

{{Enhancement}} Casting your Class Ability grants {{PVEOvershieldHP}}{{HP}} raw Overshield HP in PvE ({{PVEOvershieldDamageResistance}}{{Percent}} damage resistance) and {{PVPOvershieldHP}}{{HP}} raw Overshield HP in PvP ({{PVPOvershieldDamageResistance}}{{Percent}} damage resistance); damage resistance is separate from raw Overshield HP. Your Class Ability deals {{PVEClassAbilityDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage in PvE and {{PVPClassAbilityDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage in PvP.

Weapons.Overview:
Weapons grants you passive Reload Speed and Handling bonuses and increases your weapons' damage against Minor and Elite combatants.

When enhanced, it increases your weapons' damage against Minibosses, Champions, Bosses, and Players. It also grants you a chance of spawning Large Ammo Bricks through the Ammo Meter system.
Weapons.BaseStatTooltip:
Your weapons' Reload and Handling animation durations are reduced by {{ReloadSpeed}}{{Percent}} and {{Handling}}{{Percent}}, respectively.

Your weapons deal {{NonBossDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage against Minor and Elite combatants.
Weapons.EnhancedStatTooltip:
Your weapons' Reload and Handling animation durations are reduced by {{ReloadSpeed}}{{Percent}} and {{Handling}}{{Percent}}, respectively.

Your weapons deal {{NonBossDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage against Minor and Elite combatants.

{{Enhancement}} Primary and Special weapons deal {{SpecialDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage and Power weapons deal {{PowerDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage against Minibosses, Champions, and Bosses. All weapons deal {{PVPDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage against Players.

You have a {{LargeAmmoBrickChance}}{{Percent}} chance of spawning Large Ammo Bricks through the Ammo Meter system.

ChargeBasedScaling: The passive recharge speed of {{AbilityName}} is increased by {{ChargeBasedScaling|ChargeList}} when you have {{ChargeCount|ChargeList}} active charges stored up.

Movement.Overview: Hidden Mobility is measured in stat points, up to 130. Mobility increases walking speed from 30 to 130. Sprint speed does not depend on Mobility. Additive bonuses apply to the base lane before multiplicative bonuses, then speed caps apply. Jump height is not included because measured apex values are not published yet.
Movement.WalkSpeed: Forward walk speed is 5.6 m/s at 0–30 Mobility, then 5 + 0.02 times your hidden Mobility stat up to 7.6 m/s at 130. Forward movement, including sprint, is capped at 9 m/s. Forward multipliers affect forward walking and sprint, but never strafing.
Movement.StrafeSpeed: Walking left, right, or backward uses 0.85 times your base walk speed, with a cap of 6 m/s. Forward-only bonuses do not apply.
Movement.CrouchSpeed: Crouching uses 0.55 times your walking speed, in either direction, with a cap of 4 m/s. Forward-only bonuses apply while crouch-walking forward, not while crouch-strafing.
Movement.SprintSpeed: Base sprint speed is 8 m/s for Titans and Warlocks, and 8.6 m/s for Hunters. Non-stacking sprint boosts (such as movement Exotics) raise base sprint speed to at least 8.5 m/s before multipliers. Lightweight weapons provide a 1.0625 forward multiplier that stacks up to the 9 m/s cap.
